name: HelixMind
description: HelixMind lists a no-card free Seed API plan.
overview: Helix Seed lists 50 requests per rolling 24 hours, 3 per minute, a 10,000-token input limit and four models. The public catalog does not clearly identify the four included models in its unfiltered view; confirm plan eligibility before calling. The auto-model route is listed as free, but its inclusion in Seed has not been verified.
free_access: Four included models; exact free-plan list unconfirmed
notes: Catalog lists auto-model as free; Seed eligibility unconfirmed. Base URL https://helixmind.online/v1.
